name: rad-plan
description: Interview-driven, risk-first implementation planning for Codex with release maps, mechanical linting, adversarial review, rescue, replan, and plan-audit workflows. It plans work and documentation; it does not implement application code.

interface.shortDescription: Build, rescue, update, and audit executable project plans.
interface.longDescription: RAD Plan runs an evidence-backed discovery interview, creates Now/Next/Later release maps and executable milestone/task plans, mechanically validates plan structure, and uses Codex subagents for stack evaluation and adversarial risk review. It also rescues unclear projects, re-baselines plans from git evidence, and audits existing plans without implementing application code.
defaultPrompt: Create a risk-first implementation plan for this project.
Rescue this unclear project and rebuild its plan from evidence.
Review docs/plan.md for mechanical and architectural risks.
